purpose: Compare same-binary RA37 OMP2 continuous 12:00-16:00 output with own-arm OMP1 and OMP2 restarts from their 15:00 checkpoints.
comparisons: Continuous first four history records (12:00-15:00) must be byte-identical to the completed 3-hour OMP2 history; hourly restart scheduling must not alter the earlier trajectory.
For each own restart, strict ordered 15:00/16:00 history against continuous history indices 3 and 4 for all 225 variables; raw dtype/shape/value bytes exact.
For each own restart, full 16:00 checkpoint against continuous 16:00 checkpoint; raw dtype/shape/value bytes exact.

Own OMP1 vs OMP2 restart histories and checkpoints exact. Metadata must match except the explicitly expected global START_DATE 12:00 to 15:00 restart anchor; any additional difference fails and is reported.
requirements: Both 3h RA37 OMP1 and OMP2 runs must already PASS and their own 15:00 checkpoints must pass finite/default-fill checks.
Continuous history times must be exactly 12:00,13:00,14:00,15:00,16:00.

Restart histories must be exactly 15:00,16:00 and checkpoint exactly 16:00. The namelist explicitly sets `override_restart_timers=.true.` so restart alarms use the new 60-minute intervals, and `write_hist_at_0h_rst=.true.` to preserve the 15:00 starting record.
Every result remains separately pinned to the posthoc-attested c694e0bb fresh binary, source, dependency and runtime-library inventory.

input_wrf.F.finding: override_restart_timers resets restart-only alarm seconds from configured restart interval; enabled for 15:00→16:00 restart.
